title: Evaluation of MD60002 Device for Facial Skin Aging
official: Performance and Safety Evaluation of the MD60002 Device in the Treatment of Skin Imperfections Due to Aging
summary:
This single-center, non-controlled, single-arm clinical study is designed to evaluate the performance and safety of the Class III investigational device MD60002 (composed of highly purified polynucleotides at 3%) for aesthetic use in the treatment of skin imperfections and wrinkles caused by physiological facial aging.

A total of 43 adult subjects presenting with facial wrinkles (Lemperle Wrinkle Severity Scale score ≥ 1) will be enrolled. Participants will receive intradermal injections of MD60002 according to a standardized protocol.

The primary endpoint is the evaluation of aesthetic improvement measured by the change in the Lemperle Wrinkle Severity Scale (LWSS) score from baseline to the 30-day follow-up visit. Secondary endpoints include patient-reported subjective satisfaction evaluated via the Global Aesthetic Improvement Scale (GAIS), alongside comprehensive safety, tolerability, and device deficiency monitoring in accordance with ISO 14155 guidelines.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Adults aged between 18 and 65 years. Presence of facial skin defects/wrinkles with a Lemperle Wrinkle Severity Scale (LWSS) score ≥ 1 at baseline.

Signed written informed consent to participate in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

Subjects aged under 18 or over 65 years. Presence of concomitant skin diseases, active infections, or inflammation in the area to be treated.

Known severe allergies, hypersensitivity to hyaluronic acid or any component of the investigational product, or history of anaphylactic reactions.

History of autoimmune diseases, severe chronic/systemic pathologies, or bleeding/coagulation disorders.

History of hypertrophic scars, keloids, or abnormal cicatrization. Recent aesthetic treatments (e.g., dermal fillers, botulinum toxin, laser, chemical peels) in the target anatomical area within the preceding months.

Pregnant or breastfeeding women (negative pregnancy test required at screening for women of childbearing potential).

Concomitant conditions or therapies that, in the opinion of the Investigator, could compromise subject safety or interfere with study evaluations.
